# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 Package 4, Chagatai 1347 Split & Eurasian Building-Type Governors (oe_eug_). Generated by gen_eurasia_governors.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Lightweight regional fallback monthly pulse for Chagatai 1347 split & Eurasian governors (slot 50).
# When BYZ scheduler slot 50 has already run this month, oe_eug_ran_m == oe_eug_m_now and this trigger is false.
# Keeps all dynamics active if BYZ falls or before slot 50 is registered in gen_mainline_lock.py.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_eug_fallback_pulse } }

oe_eug_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        NOT = { global_var:oe_eug_ran_m ?= oe_eug_m_now }
        OR = {
            oe_eug_human_fallback_eligible = yes
            tag = DLH
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:DLH } tag = MAM }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:DLH } NOT = { country_exists = c:MAM } tag = HUN }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:DLH } NOT = { country_exists = c:MAM } NOT = { country_exists = c:HUN } tag = CHG }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_eug_monthly = yes
    }
}
